highlights.text: BRIGHTON LEAD! Hitting his old club where it hurts, Welbeck slots home a 10-yard finish from the centre of the area, following Adingra's low cross from the right! He stays cool to steer the ball into the net, leaving Onana well beaten and putting Brighton 1-0 ahead at Old Trafford!
Another assist for Lamptey: he passes the ball into Joao Pedro's path and watches on as the ball then nestles into the back of the net.

THE SEAGULLS STRIKE AGAIN! Brighton extend their advantage, as Mitoma and Lamptey combine on the left side of the area, before the latter's pass picks out Gross, who steers the ball into the net from near the penalty spot! It was not great defending from the hosts, but the away fans don't care: 2-0 to Brighton!
SAVE! Closing down the angle at his near post, Onana keeps out a prodded shot from close range by Mitoma, who seemed set to score Brighton's fourth goal when set free by Joao Pedro's throughball.

highlights.narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
highlights.text: SAVE! Once again, Joao Pedro drops deep to feed in an attacking colleague, as he picks out Ferguson's run into the box from the right.

SUPER STOP! Onana prevents the hosts' embarrassment becoming more acute, as he dives low to his left in order to keep out Ansu Fati's goalbound strike! Gilmour sent the young loanee through, and he really should have scored!

highlights.narrative_context: sudden early moment with little build-up
highlights.text: SAVE! Steele sticks out a leg to deny Rashford at the near post! After a direct run from the Man United forward, he reaches the byline and eludes Veltman's challenge; however, his close-range shot lacks conviction and allows Brighton's goalkeeper to make the save.

MISS! Once again, Rashford drifts in from the left and sets up a shot at goal, but his attempt is skewed narrowly wide of the right-hand post! He's created plenty of openings during the first half, but not quite been able to finish it all off.
Rashford's latest attempt sails straight into the waiting gloves of Steele, who comfortably repels the United striker's dipping 20-yard free-kick.
